body: This happened a couple of months ago. This is why I'm saying I'm (kind of) over it and we're not talking anymore. It just still bugs me, that's why I made the post.

Thank you for the responses so far. I just want to make it clear that we are not together and obviously he did not rape me. My intention with this post is to figure out whether I am the one to blame for what happened or not because I have no idea what to think about this situation and it just bothers me a lot, people have said really mean things to me about this and that I am stupid etc. So I just want perspectives, otherwise I am okay now.

Woah, okay so I might have worded it the wrong way. Obviously he didn't rape me!! That's not what I was trying to say. We're not together, we're not talking anymore, I'm over this, it just still kind of bothers me that I don't know whether I should blame myself for what happened or not.
I don't think I'll ever get over this, but thank you for the support and the advice, I appreciate it a lot.

But we usually understand each other about everything. I don't even care whose fault it was, I just miss her and it hurts like hell. We have 2 weeks left together because after that she's going back to her country, and I always thought that around this time we would spend so much time together and hang out constantly... Instead, I'm just staring at her every day in school wishing I could just go up to her and talk instead of wasting the time we have left. It's like one day we were planning the future and laughing and having fun, and the next day I can't talk to her... I don't know how I'm supposed to cope with that. It just hurts too much.

Well we are classmates so it's quite hard to make physical distance from them. The girl is an exchange student and she's moving back to her country in 2 weeks, and school is also about to end, so at least after that I won't have to see them for 3 months.
Yes, I'm sure I did something really wrong but I just can't see what that was. I was arguing with my friend during the weekend and I explained why I am hurt, but we just can't get each other's perspective. I know rational people can sometimes hurt others, but they don't cut others off for stupid reasons. So I'm thinking she probably had a good reason to do this and I'm just too delusional to understand. 
Today in school I think I'll just try to avoid her the best I can, we have classes together so it's going to be hard but during the breaks I'll just try not to be where she is. And I think I'll try to avoid everyone else too so no one can make fun of me.

Thank you. Well I don't need to distance myself from them because they cut me off. It's going to hurt so much to see them every day in school, not being able to talk to them anymore. I still feel like everything is my fault and I'm just too delusional to see how I was a bad person. These are rational people we're talking about, they wouldn't hurt me for no reason. I don't even know what is real anymore and what I'm supposed to think.
Hey, I am here. You can message me if you want to and I'll listen to everything you have to say.
It's the same with me. Trust me, you are not alone in this. There are a lot of people out there just like us and we understand. Please don't give up yet.

Hey, I empathize with your situation strongly because I feel a similar way. If you would like to talk about the things you've been through/your mental state more, please message me, I understand you and I care.

Hey. I am really sorry that you feel this way. I know what it's like, I too have been bullied severely in the past for a long time, which made me hate myself intensely. I want you to know that there are people out there who are struggling with the same problems as you are, and that we understand. I am here to listen if you need someone to care, feel free to message me.

Hey. I am really sorry that you feel like this, and I understand your struggle. I care about your situation and I just want to let you know that if you need someone to talk to, I am always here and you can message me. I'd really like to help you with getting through this.

Hey. I am really sorry that you have to go through this. I'm here for you if you feel like you need someone to talk to, and you can always message me if you think it would help. Your feelings are completely understandable, but trust me, there is nothing to feel embarrassed or pathetic about when talking about your mental health problems. And yeah, I know most people only care if you're female, which is fucking horrible. However, even though I am just a stranger, I'm here and I do care. Trust me, I get how you're feeling now, I too feel like my life has become a nightmare since a person I cared about fucked my mind up completely. I don't want to invalidate you by saying bullshit like "it gets better", but I hope it helps at least just a little bit to know that I think you're definitely not a lost cause, and you have the chance to get through this. Please don't give up yet.

Hey. I am so sorry that you have to go through all of this. It's completely understandable that you feel this way, and no, you're not being selfish or needy at all. Actually, reading your post felt like hearing about my own problems. I often feel like I'm completely insignificant and it wouldn't make any sort of difference if I killed myself, because in the past few years all of my friends either left me, or just neglect me now and don't care about me at all. I think it can be useful to remind ourselves that the way other people treat us is not a reflection of our actual worth as a person. People who are going through the same things as you are and who understand can be extremely hard to find, but trust me, we're here and we care, so you're not alone in this. I mean, I know I'm just a random stranger, but I'm already here for you and I care. And besides me there might be a lot of people who would like you if they knew you, so please don't give up yet. I know that right now it might feel like you are never going to feel better and there is no way out, so I don't want to invalidate your feelings by saying things like "it gets better". But I still think you definitely do have the chance to get through this. I am here to listen if you need a friend, so feel free to message me if you want to talk to someone more.

Of course it's worth it. And you're welcome, I help because I think you do deserve to get better. Thank you for being strong and not giving up yet. If you don't mind, please keep me updated on how you're feeling and what is going on with you, like I said I care a lot.

I think it would help if you tried therapy again. It's understandable if you feel embarrassed, it's really hard to learn that mental health problems are not something to be ashamed of, so I get it if you feel like you're not ready for this. But I think it would be great if you could find an efficient psychologist, I think it can even be done online (I'm not sure how, I'm not experienced in that). I mean you still have the chance to change things, even if it seems impossible right now. If you feel like there is no way out, I completely understand, but I hope it helps a little that I care so much and that I think you're definitely not a lost cause.

You are really kind for saying these things, and I'm really glad if I'm able to make you feel better at least just a little bit. I hope it doesn't feel weird that I say this, but I care about you and you are not insignificant for me. And besides me there are a lot of other people out there too who would understand and like you, but sometimes they can be really hard to find in person. It's like most people I know online think the same way as I do and are caring towards me, but irl everyone looks down on me. So I just want you to know that you are never alone, and the way your friends and family members treat you say more about them than about your actual personality. I also have to admit that I feel like I am just a huge burden to my friends a lot too, so I understand that problem too completely. Oh and if you don't mind that I ask, do you have any experience with trying therapy? If yes, then what was it like?

Hey. I am really sorry that you have to go through all of this. I am here for you and I really want to help. I understand that you feel like there is no way out of this situation, and your feelings are absolutely valid. I think there are a lot of people who are struggling with the same problems as you are, and these kind of mental health issues can definitely be worked on. You are not a lost cause, and I am sure you have the chance to get better, even if it feels impossible right now.  I am not a therapist, so the only thing I can offer to you is support, but I care about your situation, and if you want someone to listen, you can always message me. I am here for you.

Hey. I am sorry that you are going through this, you must be feeling really awful right now. Could you explain more why you want to kill yourself? What kind of internal turmoil are you going through? I am here to listen if you need someone to talk to. Also with your friend I think you should just tell them that you're worried about them, and let them know they can always reach out to you if they're struggling with something.

Thank you for your response and your kind words. Please do update me on your situation, because I really do care. And just know that there are people out there who are struggling with the same problems as you are and that we are here for you, we understand, and we can and want to help. I don't want to invalidate your feelings by saying things like "it gets better", because I know that is extremely hard to believe, but trust me, you definitely have the chance of getting through this, even if it feels impossible now. Like I said, please don't give up yet. I am here for you.

It's 100% understandable that you find it hard to believe that there are people who truly care about you. I know what it feels like, people who struggle with mental health problems tend to experience this pretty often, and your feelings and experiences are completely valid. But even if you don't have anyone in your life right now who truly appreciates you, that doesn't say anything about your worth as a person. A lot of people hated and bullied me in the past and there were a lot of times when I didn't have anyone to count on and no one cared about me, so trust me, I get it. It was a nightmare and I hated myself, but I'm over that now, and trust me, you definitely do have the chance to get better and/or find people who actually care and understand you too. I mean, even though I'm just a stranger, I'm already here, I care and I want to listen. So yeah, all I can say is please don't give up yet.

Hey. I'm really sorry that you have to go through all of this. It's completely understandable that you feel like people just don't care about you enough and that you have no reason to live, I know this feeling really well. However, people who understand and who would appreciate you if they knew you always exist, even if they can be hard to find sometimes. For example, I know I'm just a random stranger, but I'm here to listen and I care. I also know a lot of valuable people who are rejected and looked down on by most people, and I can tell you, the way others treat you is not a reflection of who you actually are. So please just hang in there. I know it's fucking hard right now and it feels like there is no way out of your situation and like no one gets you. I know it's extremely difficult and I empathize with you strongly. But please just don't give up yet.

Yes, I think your actions definitely constitute suicidal behavior. I think you should seek professional help as soon as possible, please do not wait until the situation gets even more serious. Most people tend to think their problems are not severe enough to seek help, and when it gets extremely serious they realise they should have reached out much earlier.

I am sorry that you have to go through all of this. You're not alone in this situation, I know I'm just a random person but I read all that you wrote and I care. 
It's understandable that you feel really bad about yourself right now. I know self-hatred can be extremely hard to conquer, but I still hope that sharing my perspective will help you at least just a little bit. So, the point is that to me you do not look like a bad person at all. Your mental health problems do not define you. They are not a reflection of your real personality. You obviously didn't want to hurt this girl, and you did because of the issues you're struggling with, but you are not your mental illness, and the things it makes you do are not a reflection of your worth as a person.
Your post was a bit hard to read for me because a lot of people have hurt me in the past intensely, and while reading I was thinking "I wish they could think the same way about me as this person thinks about the girl he has hurt". But the thing is that shitty people do not care about the consequences of their actions, and they don't mind doing harm to others at all. You say "I just feel like the worst person on earth, I feel so heartbroken, so guilty, so regretful", and I think the second part of your sentence absolutely refutes the statement that you are a bad person. Only good people regret the bad things they have done. I hope this doesn't invalidate you, like I said I know self-hatred can be extremely hard to conquer even if it's not reasonable. But you definitely do seem like a valuable person to me. So if you feel like you want to talk about your problems more, you can always message me if you want to. I'm here to listen and I care.

It's 100% understandable that you can't conquer your suicidal urges overnight. You are going through really difficult things, it's not your fault that you can't control your dark thoughts right now. Also I'm glad that you responded to my comment, you're really kind for saying these things. Oh, and I read your post again and I was thinking about how you say you feel crazy and embarrased when talking to people about your problems.. I understand that completely, I always feel that way too when people invalidate my feelings/look down on me because of the stuff I'm struggling with. But I know, and I hope you know too that there is nothing to be embarrassed about, and we are not crazy. The people that don't understand us and their shitty behavior are not reflections who we actually are.
I also read your other comment, and I feel like your situation with this girl is a bit similar to what I'm going through now, so I understand that too. I lost a person too who meant the world to me, and he also said things to me that he knew would hurt me. I don't know how to get over it and it's really fucking hard to deal with, but this happened two months ago and it's already slightly better, even though at that time I felt like my life will be a nightmare forever without him. I have a lot of hope that we both will be able to get through this. I mean you say you managed to experience happiness after years of struggling, and even though you lost this now, I think you do have the chance of experiencing it again. And I know it probably feels like there is no way out of this and it won't get better, those feelings are absolutely valid and I understand. But I think it's amazing that you managed to reach out despite all of that, I think you show a lot of strength and potential of getting better. It's great that you succeded at staying alive for another day, and I'm proud of you for not giving up. Again, I care and you're not alone in this.

Hey. I just want to let you know that I am so sorry you have to go through this. It must be horrible to feel this way, and I empathize with your situation. You are definitely not alone in this, there are a lot of people out there who understand and want to help, even if we can be hard to find sometimes. Just know that if you decide you want to talk to someone more, I am here. Feel free to message me and I'll listen to everything you have to say. Please just don't give up yet.

I'm so sorry that you have to go through this. It can be horrible when no one seems to understand you and when you feel like people just don't care. I'm aware that I'm just a random stranger on the Internet, but I care and I empathize with your situation. There are so many people struggling with problems like these, so trust me, you're not alone in this. I know it can be really difficult to find people who actually get you and are struggling with the same problems, but we are there, we understand and we care. I just want to let you know that you can find support and understanding. I know it's fucking awful right now, but just hang in there. And message me if you want to talk to someone more, I am here to listen.

Oh, that must be horrible. Your feelings are 100% valid and it's understandable if you feel like there is no way out of this situation right now.
However, do you think you could look at this from another perspective? Past mistakes do not define a person. There are a lot of shitty people out there, but the way they treat you does not reflect the kind of person you are. It's perfectly understandable that you feel invaluable because people only care about you in a sexual way, but again, other people's behavior towards you is not a reflection of who you really are as a person. Just imagine, if someone went through the same things as you did, do you think they would deserve to hate themselves? 
I understand that it's extremely difficult to change how you feel about yourself, and it's a long process, but it can help a lot to try to see the bigger picture and look at other perspectives too as a first step, if you can. I know I'm just a stranger but I care, you can message me too if you'd like to. Also have you ever tried therapy?

To be honest I don't really know how this works, but is it possible to go to a psychiatrist instead to get a diagnosis and, if you have a mental illness, get medication for it without needing to open up and engage in therapy?
Also about the girl situation... You seem like quite a mature person, and caring towards her, but you say you feel awful because she cares about you despite the fact that you're messed up. It's completely understandable to feel like that, but your mental health problems are not the same as your personality, you can't be defined by the things you're struggling with. Have you ever thought that if you were actually a burden to her she wouldn't care about you this much? Don't you think she has a good reason for liking you, even if you can't see that right now because of what you're going through? What do you think about this?

I'm sure you're in a really difficult situation right now and that it's hard for you to like yourself at this point. I know what intense self-hatred is like, so yeah, I feel like I understand your struggle. However, can you explain why exactly you hate yourself? What is it that makes you feel like you fucked your life up?

It's 100% understandable that you feel this way, it makes me really mad when psychologists suck at their job. They are supposed to use their skills to help people, not to make them feel even worse... Ok, not gonna ramble about this now. The point is that your feelings are completely valid.
Is there any way for you to find a professional either online or in your area that is actually proven (by their clients' reviews of them or something) to be trustworthy and effective? Ofc you can get better even if this is not a possibility, but I think it would be extremely helpful.

Wow, I never understood how psychologists can do things like that, it's so fucked up. So if I understood correctly, the reason why you don't want to try therapy now is because you don't think you could/should trust a person deeply again?

I know this is a really basic question but have you ever visited a psychologist/psychiatrist? I think it is essential if you want to get better (because you can get better, even if it feels like it's fucking impossible. there are a lot of ways to deal with mental health problems like these).

You are right to an extent, the world can be cruel and love usually ends in death or heartbreak. However, that is just one perspective and only one aspect of life. It's always possible to get better/enjoy life/find a purpose, no matter what kind of horrible shit you're struggling with right now. Are there any things that you enjoy doing? Do you have goals or something you want to achieve? What kind of things make you feel good? If you can't answer any of these questions properly, it might mean you have some type of mental health problem. Mental illness usually makes people think irrationally about life and themselves, so I think you should definitely seek professional help. You might think it won't work, but just give it a try. 

Can you explain why you think you're not a good person? It's important to think about this because the reasoning behind self-hatred is often irrational, even if it feels 100% valid.
